trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum capstone, so it has no steps of its own. Finish the other 54 trophies and it triggers on its own, usually a few seconds after the last one. There is nothing to miss and no order to follow, but expect the online-only style extras to be the ones that hold you up, so clear them early.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist lives under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and only appears once the main story is finished, yet everything you did beforehand already counts toward it. PowerPyx notes the list is really about 60% of the game's content: roughly 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations and 15 of 18 meditation spots. Work through it category by category rather than chasing the counter, and note that nothing on it can be permanently missed.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all feed the same counter, so you can mix them freely and only need any 250 of the game's 397. The fastest route is to sweep stunt jumps by district using a map and save the awkward knife flights for last. Because 100% Completion demands 300 stunts, keep going past this trophy instead of stopping at 250.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: You need a gold medal on every Shooting Range challenge in the game, and they are repeatable so nothing here is missable. Output Lag reports the medals spread over 12 ranges for 42 golds total, though a rival count claims two ranges hold all 42 between them, so confirm the layout against GTABase before you plan a route. Practise the reload timing on each weapon first, since gold targets are tight and usually reward headshots and clean streaks.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults are opened through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Tail an armored van until it stops at a large bank, slip inside while the guard still has the vault door open, and bring your partner along because you cannot haul every bag of cash alone. Each hit instantly gives you 4 stars, so park a fast bike or car right outside the doors before you go in. You only need 5 of the 8 vaults for the trophy, but 100% Completion wants all 8.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Not every stranger strand counts toward this: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete all register, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy either have their own trophies or are excluded entirely. Because the game never tells you which ones register, open the trophy's own progress counter after finishing each strand and check whether it moved. Race Against Yago is time-sensitive, so drop whatever you are doing and complete it as soon as it appears on the map.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 Collectible Card sets hidden around Leonida and you only need to finish any 3 of them. Each set is a handful of cards tied to a theme and a location, so open the collection menu and pick the three sets with the fewest missing cards rather than hunting blind. Note the cards you already picked up while free-roaming, then fill the gaps one set at a time. Nothing expires, so this can be cleaned up after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It means taking an in-game photo at a discoverable location, and any mix of the four categories counts. The world holds 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and a set of No Flusher toilet tags, which is far more than the 100 you need, so you can ignore whichever type you find tedious. Pull out the phone, frame the prompt icon until it locks, and snap; the counter ticks up immediately and nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: This one asks only that you sample all 9 activity types at least once, so performance does not matter and you can lose every attempt. The categories cover things like stunt jumps, races, shooting ranges, triathlons and side jobs, and most unlock naturally as you explore. Open the activities menu as you go and tick off a type you have never touched whenever you see its icon. It can be finished at any point before or after the story.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: There are 40 races in Leonida and this requires first place in 20 different ones, since re-winning the same event does nothing for the counter. Pick a fast, well-handling car and work through the street and circuit races district by district, using the race menu to see which events still show no win. Lower the difficulty if you only care about the trophy; the races stay available after the campaign, so nothing can be lost.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need a 4 star wanted level, your partner in the car with you, and a clean escape. The smoothest setup is a bank vault hit, which drops you straight to 4 stars with your partner alongside. Break line of sight, switch to a quiet vehicle if you can, and keep driving out of the search circle. The trophy only fires once you have crossed out of the red heat zone entirely, not when the flashing search area simply stops moving.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner to your side first, then rob three shops in one continuous run while the police are actively chasing you. Choose three stores close together so you can hop between them before the heat dies, and keep the wanted level alive the whole time. If the stars fade down to just the red heat zone, the chain is broken and you have to start over. It can take around 30 seconds after leaving the third shop for the trophy to appear, so keep driving rather than reloading a save.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so you never need to steal anything. Keep the phone ready while you drive and snap every model you pass, including parked cars, boats and aircraft. The base game has 277 models and 100% Completion asks for 200 of them, so treat this as the first half of that grind. Nothing is time-limited and traffic respawns endlessly.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: This tracks map fog, so you need to reveal every region of Leonida rather than visit every collectible. A plane is by far the quickest tool: fly long straight passes across the state, then sweep the coastal edges and the islands that ground travel tends to skip. Check the map after each pass for any grey patches left behind and mop them up before landing. Fog clearing is permanent, so a save made mid-sweep is perfectly safe.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Illegal operations are the gang-held properties that show up on your map once you start scouting crime around Leonida, and this only asks for one hit against each of the nine gangs. Read the operation's tag before you go in, because a repeat of the same gang does nothing for the trophy. Thirty-nine operations exist in total and clearing all of them is what 100% Completion wants, so treat this as the early slice of that grind.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are the dirty cash you lift from bank jobs and payday loan stores, and they only become clean money when a contact launders them for you. This is a running total, so keep feeding whoever gives the best rate rather than spreading the work around. Yasmani takes the smallest cut of the contacts, which makes her the quickest route to the quarter million.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races are the timed checkpoint courses flown with a quadcopter, and each of the fourteen locations has its own set. You only need a single first place at each location for the trophy, not a clean sweep. Winning all forty-two races across the map is a separate ask that 100% Completion makes, so note which locations you have already topped.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Every purchase counts here, whether it is clothing, ammo, food, vehicle upgrades or property, and the spend is tracked as one cumulative figure. You will clear it naturally while buying gear for heists, so there is no need to shop deliberately. If you want it early, buy weapons and car mods you were going to need anyway instead of wasting cash on things you never use.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are eight garages for sale in total, listed in the Vice City Real Estate app, and together they cost roughly $160,000. The app only opens up after you finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, so this cannot be rushed at the start. The four garages the story hands you are not purchasable and do not count, so make sure every one of your eight is a paid listing.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses hands you the Scooter Bros app during the Chapter 2 mission of the same name, which is what lets you launder a stolen car into your own name. Drive a boosted vehicle to Moses, pick Respray and then Register, and repeat until ten cars are logged. From Chapter 3 a standard tracker bought at any Pay 'n' Spray does the same job, but each registered car needs a free garage slot, so buy your garages before you start stockpiling.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal starts texting you once you have cleared a Chapter 1 mission, and his message drops a purple icon on the map marking where he is waiting with a rod. Turn up, take the challenge and land more or bigger fish than he does. Nothing here is timed or missable, so you can come back with better gear if the first attempt goes badly.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Arcade cabinets sit inside the bars and clubs around Leonida, and each one holds a small playable game. Pick any cabinet and finish its game rather than just dropping a few coins, since only a completed run pops the trophy. Choose the shortest shooter or puzzler on the cabinet list if you are doing this purely for the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are eighteen meditation spots spread over ten locations, and you can sit at each one as Jason and as Lucia. Bring whichever partner is available every time, because a spot you meditate at alone may not register as both characters, and the final spot needs the pair playable together, which only opens after Chapter 2. The one to watch is the very first: Lucia's balcony meditation at home in Chapter 1, which appears after the mission Down to Earth when you check the kitchen in the morning and follow her out. That spot vanishes when Chapter 1 ends and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy requires it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the pop. 100% Completion only wants fifteen of the eighteen spots, so a missed one costs you nothing toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode you trigger by clicking L3 and R3 while aiming, and the meter has to be full before it will fire. Bank a charge by playing normally, then pick a crowded fight such as the guards patrolling an illegal operation and go in with an assault rifle. Adrenaline lengthens the slow-motion window, which makes five clean kills far easier if you are struggling.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Jewelry store robberies unlock in Chapter 3 through the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which also puts the Snap Gun in your hands. Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door instead of kicking it, because a kick trips the alarm and ruins the run. Once inside the back room, read the note holding the safe code, empty the safe and walk out unseen; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a forgiving target. If anyone spots you, reload the save and try again.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run fixed routes and can be hit on the road, and a full bank vault job also satisfies this if you get away clean. The trophy is not awarded when the cash is in your hands, only once the red heat zone around the scene has cleared. Keep driving until the zone drops, then stop worrying about the police response.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are tracked under Progress > Challenges and cover a wide mix of side content, from stunt and weapon tasks to odd jobs around the map. You only need fifty of the eighty for this trophy, and many tick over on their own as you chase other trophies. 100% Completion asks for seventy, so treat fifty as a checkpoint rather than the finish line.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission of Chapter 1, so you get it in the first hour of a new game. Follow the objective markers and finish the mission as written and the trophy pops on the results screen. There is no alternative path and nothing to miss, so this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 is the opening stretch of the campaign, running from Gone Fishing through the first big score that sets up the rest of the story. Just follow the mission markers on the map and it will land on its own once that chapter's final cutscene plays. It cannot be missed, but a manual save right after it pops is worth keeping for anything chapter-gated.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 pushes the story into the drug-running side of Leonida and hands out the mission Breakfast Run alongside the main thread. Clear every chapter mission the story offers and the trophy arrives at the chapter break. Nothing here is optional, so it comes automatically as you keep playing.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is built around The Cartel Heist and the fallout from it, and it is the point where the map opens up toward Vice City proper. Play the chapter missions in order and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Unmissable, though it is a good moment to take a manual save before the next act begins.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the longest act, covering Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown before it wraps. There is no branching that skips content, so simply working through every marked story mission finishes it. The trophy appears at the chapter's closing cutscene, and the next chapter begins immediately after.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The campaign ends with a single climactic mission that closes out the main story, and finishing it awards this gold along with the ending credits. It is unmissable, but keep a manual save from just before you launch that mission, because the world state afterwards changes and a few side jobs and activities are much easier to wrap up from that point. Reload that save if you are chasing cleanup trophies later.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is one of the Chapter 2 story missions, handed to you as you push through the chapter's main thread. It plays out as a linear set of objectives with no choices that can fail the trophy. Finish the mission and the unlock follows immediately, so there is nothing to plan around here.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the centrepiece of Chapter 3 and has you hitting a cartel operation with a crew. Prep steps are part of the mission chain, so do not wander off expecting to skip them. Clear it as written and the trophy is yours; it is a story mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play sits early in Chapter 4 and is part of the main story chain rather than an optional job. Follow the objectives and see it through; the trophy registers on the mission results screen. There is no branch or fail state that removes it, so it is purely a matter of progressing the campaign.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is another Chapter 4 story mission and continues directly from the events of the earlier chapter missions. Because it is part of the critical path you cannot skip it, and the trophy unlocks the moment the mission ends. Play the chapter in order and it arrives with everything else.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the last of the marked Chapter 4 missions before the chapter closes out. It is a straight story job with objective markers guiding you the whole way, so simply finish it. Since it is unmissable there is nothing to prepare for, though it pairs naturally with the Chapter 4 trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the Chapter 5 story mission and the last of the chapter-specific trophies before the finale. It is handed out as part of the main thread, so keep following the story markers rather than side content. Complete it as scripted and the trophy unlocks on the results screen.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's jobs are a side-character chain that unlocks alongside the story rather than inside it, and this fires on the final one in his set. Work through his jobs as they appear and finish the last before you wrap the campaign. His line stays available after the story ends, so there is no window to miss it, but note the trophy stays hidden until that finale lands.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs begin at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, and the chain opens up after a Chapter 2 mission. Run all five and the last one awards this trophy. Nothing here expires when the story finishes, so you can save the whole set for cleanup, but starting the chain early means the jobs do not pile up at the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is another side character with his own short set of jobs, and this unlocks on the last mission he offers. His chain becomes available as you move through the story, so check the map for his marker between chapters. Like the other side-character finales it remains open after the credits, which makes it safe to leave for last.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's jobs sit off the main story thread, so you reach the finale only after clearing the earlier favours he hands out. Follow his contact markers whenever they appear and finish the last one to unlock the trophy. It is not tied to any chapter cutoff, so the string can be wrapped up after the campaign ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's side string runs parallel to the story and only finishes once you have done the run of missions he gives out. Work through his markers in order and the last one pops the trophy. Like the other side-character finales it stays available after the credits, so nothing is lost if you leave it late.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line is Jason-only, so switch to him before starting it. His target decks point you at the animals to bring down, and a clean shot to the head or heart keeps the carcass in good enough shape to hand in. The animal for this particular request is not confirmed yet, so treat the deck marker as your only dependable lead and save before you head out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International and take one of the big airliners parked at a boarding bridge — the gates E3 and E4 aircraft are the ones that work, while planes sitting elsewhere on the apron do not count. Climb into the cockpit, reverse away from the terminal, line up on the runway and get airborne. The trophy waits until you are roughly a kilometre out from the airport, so keep flying and keep the police off you; save beforehand because the response is immediate.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Mile Zero Air Station sits on the island in the far south-west corner of the map, and the Rhino tanks should be parked along its southern side. Make a manual save before you go in, then hop in, drive it off the base and fire the main gun a few times until the trophy registers. Expect a heavy response once you are moving, so have an escape route in mind.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kolt & Associates runs Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation in Port Gellhorn that you can hit from Chapter 2 onward. Pack Sticky Bombs and take all three valuables: the luxury watch in the office, the shotgun resting on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a charge. Clear the police once you are loaded up; anything you leave behind means the operation reopens later, so it costs time rather than the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is about Strength, which you raise by training rather than by fighting alone. Buy a gym membership and bring your partner along — they work out beside you and their Strength climbs at the same time. Keep the sessions going until both Jason and Lucia are maxed out and the trophy lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: You need 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile, and robberies plus fights are the reliable way to feed it — it fills naturally as you play, so no dedicated grind is needed. Watch the direction you push it in, because steering the profile all the way to Irredeemable is permanent. Spread your choices if you want to keep the ending options open.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The exact trigger for this one is still UNCONFIRMED as of 18 November 2026, so treat any step-by-step you read elsewhere with suspicion. All that is solid is the description itself: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The best lead is to find a bar with a seafront outlook along Ocean Beach and order a drink there, but nobody has verified the specific spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This trigger is UNCONFIRMED, so no verified location or vehicle has been pinned down yet. The wording does point clearly at one thing: driving a car out through the front window of a vehicle showroom rather than using the door. Beyond that, the honest answer is that the exact showroom and setup are still unknown.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The trigger for this trophy is UNCONFIRMED and the description gives very little away. It reads as a second attempt at something that failed the first time, but which activity or mission that refers to has not been established. Do not chase a specific method until the community pins one down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Another UNCONFIRMED trophy — no reliable unlock method is documented yet. The name and description suggest something strange or unexplained in Leonida, but that is speculation and not a lead worth following. Wait for a verified report before spending time on it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The unlock is UNCONFIRMED, though the description points at a melee drive-by performed at the bowling alley. In practice that means pulling alongside a pedestrian and hitting them with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, with the bowling alley as the likely setting. Try it around Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, but treat the location as a best guess rather than fact.
